svg.title: Narrower plasma and channel widths: current, sixty percent and half
svg.desc: One production ion cannon per zoom row beside three transverse width variants of the rounded plasma profile. Current width is a 2 u light core above a 1.6 u physical channel. Sixty percent uses 1.2 u above 0.96 u; half uses 1 u above 0.8 u. Channel length, wall thickness, colours, light falloff shape and axial fade are fixed. No dimensions are selected as final.
